name: DC Pressure Washing and Restoration
website_check: Google Maps listing shows 'Add website' (no website button). WebSearch for "DC Pressure Washing and Restoration" / "DC Pressure Washing" Melbourne FL found no confirmed owned domain, Instagram or Facebook for this exact business; the loosely similar results (DC Services in Miami, DC Powerwashing with no stated city) were not treated as this business.
hours: Mon-Sat 6 AM-7 PM, Sun 8 AM-7 PM

source_of_data.discovery: CHROME_PATH=/usr/bin/google-chrome python3 scripts/maps_discover.py --niche "pressure washing" --location "Melbourne, FL" --limit 8 --min-rating 4.5 --min-reviews 10 -> candidate (DC Pressure Washing and Restoration, 5.0, 52 reviews, no website, no public address on the listing)
source_of_data.detail: node scripts/gmaps_detail.js <mapsUrl> -> rating 5.0, reviews 52, phone, hours, website null, no address field published on the listing
source_of_data.reviews: node scripts/gmaps_reviews.js <mapsUrl> 10 -> 5 unique verbatim 5-star reviews after de-dup (Josh Boudreau, Lisa N, Pessolano Studios, Linda Meeks, Keith), all English, naming owners David and Christian
source_of_data.photos: node scripts/gmaps_photocycle.js <mapsUrl> 30 -> 9 unique Google Maps photos after de-dup (1 exact duplicate removed), visually curated one by one with Read tool; 8 kept as real job and equipment photos, 1 excluded (a stucco wall with a ladder mid-job, less polished than the other shots)

reviews_verbatim.author: Josh Boudreau
reviews_verbatim.text: David and his crew did an amazing job with my driveway, sidewalks, and pavers. They were wonderful with communication, and prompt to the job. Sent photos when complete and were extremely fair with pricing. Thanks again and look forward to future business with DC.

reviews_verbatim.author: Lisa N
reviews_verbatim.text: DC Pressure Washing was such a great company to deal with. I had my pavers cleaned and sealed. It came out so nice. Christian was so nice to deal with and he beat everyone else's price with excellent work!

reviews_verbatim.author: Linda Meeks
